accepted_findings.reason: Schema migrations in _ensure_columns() use sql text() with table/column names from a hardcoded specs dict and compile-time DDL fragments only; no user-controlled SQL fragments.
Homelab gateway image: non-root USER requires writable /data volume ownership; accepted risk in isolated compose stack. Hardening tracked separately.
GPU sidecar runs on trusted host network namespace; needs host /sys and nvidia-smi. Non-root USER deferred for sidecar deployment model.
Same as Semgrep missing-user: auth-gateway needs /data volume write access in default compose; non-root user planned with entrypoint chown.
GPU power sidecar is an optional host-adjacent probe service, not internet-facing multi-tenant API.
Health is enforced externally (compose restart, optional reverse proxy, manual curl /healthz). Minimal alpine image avoids redundant in-image healthcheck.
Sidecar exposes a simple HTTP /power endpoint; liveness is optional and monitored by the gateway probe caller, not orchestrator HEALTHCHECK.
Pytest and layout tests intentionally use assert; not production code paths.
Narrowing asserts after smtp_ready()/config checks for type checkers; invariants already guarded by preceding conditionals.
False match on reset_page query param default token='' (empty string), not a credential.
Best-effort probes and audit helpers: upstream/network/format failures are expected and must not break admin UI or routing.
Developer/integration scripts tolerate unreachable LAN sources; failures are non-fatal by design.
DEMO_TOOLS-only synthetic usage charts; randomness is not used for tokens, sessions, or crypto.
Sidecars listen on 0.0.0.0 inside container/host network by design; not exposed beyond trusted LAN/compose.
Local dev script writes probe artifact to /tmp; not part of runtime gateway.
Sidecar reads GPU metrics via fixed nvidia-smi/rocm-smi commands; no user-controlled shell input.
subprocess invoked with static argv lists for vendor GPU tools only.
nvidia-smi/rocm-smi resolved from PATH inside dedicated GPU sidecar image.
